title: MaterialsScience NanoparticleSynthSOP

stats.done_summary: Successfully converted the raw lab notes into a comprehensive, executable Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for pilot-scale NanoCu synthesis (`nanoparticle_sop.md`). Generated a Python script to simulate the process profile (temperature and reaction progress) and the expected color transition, saving the visualizations to `report/images/`. Finally, authored a detailed research report (`report/report.md`) documenting the methodology, process simulation results, and discussion on scaling up the synthesis.
